field.name: note
field.p: Use the enquiry date as the plan date and review the Dental Reception role. Confirm contact details, discuss availability, and agree a diary slot before creating a booking. Refer clinical questions to the practitioner.

record.field: Follow up if the enquiry remains open

field.name: note
field.p: Check the previous contact outcome before calling again. Offer help agreeing a first visit and record the next action. Close this activity if the enquiry has already been resolved.

field.name: note
field.p: Keep the single Patient Journey current and record attendance on the booking. For an unresolved enquiry, agree another dated action or use the standard Lost action with the appropriate reason. Remove remaining plan activities when they are no longer needed.

record.field: Confirm receipt of the financial proposal

field.name: note
field.p: Use the date the estimate was shared as the plan date. Ask whether the patient received it and whether reception can help with administrative questions or the next appointment. Refer clinical questions to the practitioner.

record.field: Follow up on the estimate decision

field.name: note
field.p: Review any reply before contacting the patient. Record the financial decision or agree the next follow-up date. If accepted, confirm the Sales order and arrange the next booking and any agreed deposit. Close this activity if the proposal has already been resolved.

record.field: Record the proposal outcome and reception handoff

field.name: note
field.p: Keep the quotation, opportunity stage, and next booking consistent. If the patient declines or postpones, use the standard Lost action with the appropriate reason. If the proposal remains open, agree a dated action. Cancel remaining plan activities after the decision is recorded.

field.name: note
field.p: Launch from the patient contact using the visit date. Ask about the reception experience and offer help arranging the next appointment. Keep the outcome administrative and refer clinical questions to the practitioner. Review the generated deadline when it falls outside opening days.

record.field: Review the next booking and agreed recall

field.name: note
field.p: Record the contact outcome. Confirm any agreed next visit or schedule a Call activity for the recall date agreed with the patient and practitioner. Close this activity if reception has already completed the handoff.
